notes.title: Major Update to Jormungandr
notes.content:
A long awaited update to Jormungandr is now live and brings graphical improvements, fixes, and 20 more levels of ship destruction.  There has also been a ton of tweaks and improvements to the mechanics to make the game more challenging, and to improve playability.  Major bullet points are as follows:

[list]
[*]Island coloring and textures have been significantly improved
[*]The number of levels has been increased from 20 to 40
[*]Jormungandr's head model has been improved
[*]The follower camera mechanics have been improved so it's not so jarring
[*]Multiple fixes to settings to improve reliability and usability
[*]Movement and turning speed have been tweaked
[*]Improved ship mechanics including the ability to reverse course upon collisions
[*]You now take continuous damage if you run into yourself
[*]Continuous damage is also used when you run into islands
[/list]
